report_metadata.method: Re-derive each discourse metric from raw final.json independently, then compare to discourse_summary.json.
report_metadata.independence_note: This module re-implements the arithmetic; it does not import discourse_summary.py.
report_metadata.semantic_label_policy: Never infer agreement/disagreement from overlap or candidate.case.

metric_definitions.definition: Episode length used as every rate denominator.
metric_definitions.provenance: episode.duration_s, else osd_stats.total_duration_s, else last valid turn end
metric_definitions.limitation: The last-turn-end fallback is a proxy, not true media duration.

metric_definitions.definition: Distinct diarization labels after same-speaker turn merge.
metric_definitions.limitation: Diarization labels need not correspond to people.

metric_definitions.definition: Chronologically valid speaker turns kept for analysis.
metric_definitions.limitation: Invalid records are silently excluded from every downstream metric.

metric_definitions.definition: Summed diarized speaking time over merged turns.
metric_definitions.limitation: Overlapping turns can exceed wall-clock speech time.

metric_definitions.definition: Adjacent speaker changes in the merged turn sequence.
metric_definitions.limitation: Merge gap is a heuristic; it changes the transition count.

metric_definitions.definition: Speaker transitions normalized by episode duration.
metric_definitions.limitation: Inherits duration-source and merge-gap uncertainty.

metric_definitions.definition: Detector-reconciliation overlap candidates kept.
metric_definitions.limitation: Candidates are not confirmed or human-validated overlap events.

metric_definitions.definition: Elapsed overlap time after interval union.
metric_definitions.limitation: Nested/duplicate candidates collapse; source counts are preserved separately.

metric_definitions.definition: Sum of candidate durations before union.
metric_definitions.limitation: Double counts nested and duplicate candidates.

metric_definitions.definition: Unique elapsed overlap time as a share of episode duration.
metric_definitions.limitation: Candidate-based; not a validated overlap prevalence.

metric_definitions.definition: Valid OSD-derived interruption attempts.
metric_definitions.limitation: OSD-derived operational attempts, not human-validated interruptions.

metric_definitions.definition: Attempts where exactly the interrupter holds the post-overlap floor.
metric_definitions.limitation: Rule-based, threshold-sensitive; ambiguous attempts are excluded from the rate.

metric_definitions.definition: Attempts where exactly a victim holds the post-overlap floor.
metric_definitions.limitation: Rule-based, threshold-sensitive; ambiguous attempts are excluded from the rate.

metric_definitions.definition: Attempts with no unique post-overlap floor holder.
metric_definitions.limitation: Large ambiguous share means the success/failure rule is inconclusive.

metric_definitions.definition: Different-speaker transitions within the non-overlap gap.
metric_definitions.limitation: Threshold-dependent; measures smoothness, not politeness.

metric_definitions.definition: Overlap candidates whose words are all acknowledgement tokens.
metric_definitions.limitation: Lexicon is English/Hindi and small; ASR errors and missing word timings hide backchannels.

metric_definitions.definition: Overlaps where two involved speakers both continue past overlap end.
metric_definitions.limitation: Depends on floor_hold_s and diarization quality.

metric_definitions.definition: Overlap candidates at or above the prolonged-overlap threshold.
metric_definitions.limitation: Duration alone is not a semantic judgment.

metric_definitions.definition: Share of overlaps expressing semantic agreement.
metric_definitions.limitation: Not computable: candidate.case=AGREE is detector corroboration, never semantic agreement.

metric_definitions.definition: Share of overlaps expressing semantic disagreement.
metric_definitions.limitation: Not computable without annotations or a validated classifier.

warnings.message: Overlap candidates nested inside another candidate (audit L6)

limitations: Re-derivation shares the raw final.json schema and configured thresholds with the summary.
Nested/duplicate overlap candidates collapse in the union but persist in source counts (audit L6).
Agreement/disagreement remain unavailable without annotations or a validated classifier.
A matched metric confirms arithmetic agreement, not semantic correctness of the underlying detector.
